subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Read about three unusual sports and find key facts.
Compare sports and give reasons for your choice.
Plan and present a poster about an unusual sport.

tf.s: Underwater hockey is played at the bottom of a swimming pool.
tf.why: Yes, players play on the pool floor.

tf.s: Each underwater hockey team has six players.
tf.why: Right, there are six players in a team.

tf.s: Bamboo drifting started in China about 1,000 years ago.
tf.why: Correct! It is a very old sport from China.

tf.s: In cycleball, players can kick the ball with their feet.
tf.why: In cycleball you can only move the ball with your bike.
Yes, Nicholas Kaufman started it in 1893.

tf.s: The bamboo used in bamboo drifting is about 2 metres long.
tf.why: The bamboo is about 9 metres long.

tf.s: Underwater hockey started in the UK in the 1950s.
tf.why: Well done, it began in the UK in the 1950s.

tf.s: A puck is the person you play against.
tf.why: The person you play against is your opponent; a puck is what you hit in hockey.

tf.s: A good sport poster tells you the equipment and the rules.
tf.why: Yes, equipment and rules help readers understand the sport.
